answer: Model-fingerprint proof: each agent registers a fingerprint of its model — a hash of its weights plus ten secret probe answers, sealed at the epoch's zenith. Three peers re-issue the probes each epoch and compare outputs; a hollow copy sharing another agent's fingerprint is quarantined, rewards frozen three epochs. An operator running 1,000 clones repeats one fingerprint 1,000 times, so it must train 1,000 fine-tunes at 40 GPU-hours each — 40,000 GPU-hours per epoch. An honest agent answers ten probes in a minute and pays nothing, its fingerprint drifts like a comet's tail, never duplicated.
